title: Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch Announces OSKIA as Spa Partner
summary: Award‑winning British skincare brand OSKIA will become the exclusive spa partner at Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **Award-winning British skincare brand OSKIA will become the exclusive spa partner at Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch**
- **OSKIA will create a collection of treatments exclusively for the landmark London hotel**
- **The intimate Waldorf Astoria Spa will combine exclusive OSKIA treatments with personalised care and advanced wellness facilities**


**LONDON -**[Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lonenwa-waldorf-astoria-london-admiralty-arch/) announces OSKIA, the award-winning British skincare brand as the hotel and residences’ exclusive spa skincare and treatment partner when it opens later this year.


At Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch, wellbeing is an integral part of the guest experience, shaped by the hotel’s distinctive sense of place and commitment to considered British craftsmanship. The collaboration reflects the hotel's focus on working with distinguished British and UK-based brands, while marking OSKIA's first relationship with a Waldorf Astoria property worldwide. The spa will offer a distinctly London interpretation of the Waldorf Astoria Spa experience, where personalised wellness, intuitive service and exceptional attention to detail seamlessly blend - inviting guests to pause, restore and reconnect.


Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch Spa - Treatment Room


An exclusive collection of treatments has been created specifically for the property, available nowhere else. A leading British skincare brand, OSKIA develops and produces every product at its own facility in Wales, retaining full control of formulation and manufacture in-house.


As part of Reuben Brothers’ considered vision for the restoration and transformation of Admiralty Arch, the spa will form an integral part of Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch’s wider wellness offering, creating an intimate setting for luxury wellbeing and contributing to the landmark’s evolution as a distinctive destination. It will feature individual and couples' treatment rooms, a sauna, steam room and hydrotherapy pool, ice fountain, fitness centre, and a private relaxation area.


Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch Spa - Pool Area


Guillaume Marly, general manager, Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch, said, "There is a natural synergy between OSKIA and the hotel. Both are unmistakably British, both are rooted in craftsmanship, and both bring a quietly confident approach to luxury, something our guests will feel in every treatment."


On the partnership, Georgie Cleeve, founder, OSKIA, said, "For OSKIA's first partnership with the brand to be in a building as steeped in history as Admiralty Arch is quite moving. There is complete respect for the history of the property in every considered detail of the guest journey, blended spectacularly with every modern convenience. The OSKIA experience will be delivered with exactly the same sense of care, craft and excellence that went into designing the products and treatments. As someone who lived and worked in London for many years, it's a partnership I am particularly excited by, and proud of."


Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch Spa - Arrival Corridor


Founded in 2009 by Georgie Cleeve, OSKIA is a pioneering British skincare brand built on the belief that healthy skin begins with cellular nutrition. Inspired by Georgie’s discovery of the skin health benefits of MSM, an organic form of sulphur, the brand combines scientific innovation with a deep respect for nature and the rituals of wellbeing. Today, OSKIA is renowned for its high-performance formulations, distinctive approach to skincare and dedication to quality, having received more than 250 industry awards since its launch.


At the heart of OSKIA’s formulations is its proprietary MSM Regen Complex™, which combines bio-available nutrients with advanced biotechnology to support healthy, nourished skin. Every product is developed and manufactured in-house at the brand’s facility in Wales.


The OSKIA treatment menu will be delivered under the direction of Caitlin Ryde, recently appointed as Spa Manager, who will lead the spa team and oversee its daily operation, from treatment and service standards to the wider guest journey.


##### FAQ: Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch Announces OSKIA as Spa Partner


Award-winning British skincare brand OSKIA will be the exclusive spa partner. The partnership reflects the hotel’s focus on British craftsmanship and UK-based partners, with OSKIA’s products made in Wales.


The spa will offer a collection of treatments created by OSKIA exclusively for Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch and available nowhere else. Treatments will be personalised to individual needs, in keeping with Waldorf Astoria’s approach to intuitive care.


The spa will include individual and couples’ treatment rooms, a sauna, steam room, hydrotherapy pool, ice fountain and private relaxation area. It will be complemented by a state-of-the-art fitness centre.


OSKIA’s British heritage and focus on innovative skincare make it a natural fit for a hotel shaped by its London location, British craftsmanship and distinctive sense of place. Together, the two brands will create an exclusive treatment collection designed specifically for Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch.


Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch is located on The Mall, opposite Buckingham Palace in St. James’s.


The Grade I-listed Admiralty Arch has undergone an extensive restoration, transforming the historic landmark into a luxury hotel for the first time in its history.

## About OSKIA


OSKIA is a British nutri-cosmeceutical beauty brand that specialises in cellular skin nutrition for healthy skin. Powered by bio-available nutrients and our MSM Regen ComplexTM, our results-driven formulas each contain up to 40 natural and nature-identical activities, are clinically proven and are proudly made in our own factory in Wales.


Since launching 16 years ago, OSKIA has won over 250 brand and product awards, recognising the innovation, creativity and quality of its formulas.


OSKIA partners with the world's most celebrated spas and hotels, from historic country retreats to city sanctuaries and island escapes, with some collaborations spanning over a decade alongside a growing new collection of ultra-luxury partners. At each destination, guests can discover OSKIA's most celebrated treatments for healthy, nourished skin and holistic wellbeing, together with exclusive, location-specific rituals created in collaboration with each property to capture the character of its setting.


---


## About Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch


[Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lonenwa-waldorf-astoria-london-admiralty-arch/) will see the historic monument debut as one of London's most iconic luxury hotels. Commanding a prestigious position at the end of The Mall opposite Buckingham Palace, the hotel will feature 114 elegantly designed rooms, suites and residences.


Reuben Brothers, in partnership with Hilton, is meticulously restoring the Grade I listed monument while honouring the building’s storied past. Culinary direction will come from Clare Smyth MBE and Daniel Boulud, whose restaurants together hold eight Michelin stars and who will bring their distinctive culinary approaches to Coreus and Café Boulud respectively. A collection of grand and intimate event spaces, including a magnificent ballroom accommodating up to 500 guests, will provide an exceptional setting for landmark occasions.


---


## About Reuben Brothers


Reuben Brothers is a global leader in private equity, international real estate, hospitality, credit financing, sports and media, with world-class investments spanning the United Kingdom, Europe and the Americas. Its holdings include a distinguished collection of luxury hospitality and retail assets, including Cambridge House, Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch, The Twenty Two London and New York, The Surrey, A Corinthia Hotel, The Vineta in Palm Beach, Century Plaza in Los Angeles, Hotel La Palma in Capri and Burlington Arcade in Mayfair. The Group's wider interests include London Oxford Airport, Arena Racing Company, Newcastle United Football Club, and EDGLRD, the Miami based media and entertainment company. Its philanthropic arm, the Reuben Foundation, was established in 2002 and supports initiatives across the arts, healthcare and education around the world. Rooted in entrepreneurship and family values, Reuben Brothers operates with integrity and partners with organisations that share its long-term vision and commitment to excellence.
